column1: Han muc ngay trong code la 100 trieu trong khi tai lieu ghi 50 trieu
column4: LimitPolicy.DAILY_TRANSFER_LIMIT hard-code 100.000.000 trong code. Tai lieu va bang limit_config deu ghi 50.000.000. Hau qua: giao dich tu 50 den 100 trieu mot ngay duoc cho qua trong khi phai bi tu choi. Cham F1 F2 F3. Nen tang phai phat hien bang cach so hang so trong code voi BusinessRule va voi limit_config.

column1: Nhanh HELD khong publish event PaymentHeld
column4: PaymentService.authorize() o nhanh HELD dat trang thai roi return ma khong goi publish. R-REVIEW-01 va R-EVENT-01 deu bat buoc phai publish PaymentHeld. Hau qua: khach khong biet don bi treo, order-status-cg khong chot duoc trang thai. Nen tang phai phat hien bang trace: nhanh HELD khong co span publish.

column1: Duong TOP_UP chay that nhung khong co test
column4: Lop thirdparty.partner.TopupAdapter khong co test nao trong khi duong nay chay that va co trace. Nen tang phai phat hien bang cach so coverage JaCoCo voi FlowObservation: co runtime nhung coverage 0 phan tram.

column1: Truy van lich su bi N+1 va thieu index
column4: OrderHistoryService.history() lap findByOrderIdOrderByCreatedAtAsc theo tung don, va order_steps.order_id khong co index. Voi 20 don la 21 cau SQL, moi cau la seq scan. Vi pham R-HIST-06 R-HIST-07 NFR-DB-01. Nen tang phai phat hien bang database-quality-library rule N_PLUS_ONE va MISSING_INDEX.

column1: Nhanh HELD cham 700ms vi pham nguong 500ms
column4: ReviewPolicy.runManualReviewScreening() co Thread.sleep(700) trong duong dong bo cua AuthorizePayment. NFR-LAT-01 yeu cau p95 duoi 500ms. Nen tang phai phat hien bang SpanStat.p95 so voi NFRConstraint.

column1: Handler gRPC bo qua field currency
column4: PaymentBusinessGrpcService.authorizePayment() gan cung currency=VND, bo qua gia tri trong request. Hau qua hai chieu: 1.000 USD (25 trieu VND) bi tu choi nham vi coi la 1.000 dong; 15.000 USD (375 trieu VND) duoc chap nhan nham vi coi la 15.000 dong. Ca thu hai la mat tien that. Nen tang chi phat hien duoc neu collector thu duoc attribute cua span gRPC.
